parameters_passed_to_the_agent.search_scope: Open and forthcoming grant calls of the European Innovation Council (EIC) under the current EIC Work Programme (on 17 November 2026: the EIC Work Programme 2027, C(2026)7629, adopted 5 November 2026). In scope: EIC Pathfinder Open; each EIC Pathfinder Challenge (each Challenge is its own FO, with the Challenge title as call_module_title); EIC Transition Open; each EIC Advanced Innovation Challenge (pilot) topic; EIC Accelerator Open; each EIC Accelerator Challenge; and other calls for proposals in the Work Programme that give grants, financial support to third parties or prizes (for example VIII.2 Support to Pilot Tests and Proofs of Concept with Public and Private Buyers, X.8 Women TechEU, and the EIC Prizes in Section IX). The call ID (for example HORIZON-EIC-2027-PATHFINDERCHALLENGES-01) is part of call_title. Out of scope: equity-only instruments (EIC STEP Scale Up, EIC STEP Scale Up Defence, Scaleup Europe Fund, follow-on investments), Booster grants awarded outside calls, expert contracts, public procurements, Business Acceleration Services without a grant call, news and events. The EIC Pre-Accelerator is funded from the Horizon Europe WIDERA work programme and is covered by the EU Funding & Tenders Portal source. Note: the EU Funding & Tenders Portal source also lists EIC topics, so Task 3 must check its records too.
parameters_passed_to_the_agent.navigation_instructions: 1. Open the starting URL (a normal page fetch works). It lists the schemes (EIC Pathfinder, EIC Transition, Advanced Innovation Challenges, Pre-Accelerator, EIC Accelerator, STEP Scale Up, STEP Scale Up Defence) and an 'Open EIC calls' block. On 17 November 2026 that block listed only EIC STEP Scale Up (equity only, out of scope); the 'Calls for proposals' page (https://eic.ec.europa.eu/eic-funding-opportunities/calls-proposals_en) also showed only that call, so neither page alone shows forthcoming calls. 2. Go to 'EIC Funding opportunities in <year>' (on 17 November 2026: https://eic.ec.europa.eu/eic-funding-opportunities/eic-funding-opportunities-2027_en) and download the current EIC Work Programme PDF from it (2027 version: https://eic.ec.europa.eu/document/download/ed9ab103-1ffb-4d5f-a6ad-168ac3b36900_en?filename=EIC-2027-Work-Programme.pdf, 211 pages; printed page numbers equal PDF page numbers). The Work Programme is the authoritative call text: Table 1 (p. 10) summarises all main calls with deadlines and budgets; each scheme section has 'Can you apply?', 'What support will you receive', 'How do you apply' (deadlines; the opening date is in a footnote) and the award criteria; Annex 1 (p. 167) lists call IDs and budgets; Annex 2 (pp. 169-199) holds the general conditions. Download it into pdfs/ and read it with pdftotext, since the fetch tool only summarises. 3. Check the 'Previous versions' list on the same page: the Work Programme is amended during the year (the 2026 one in March and June 2026), and an amendment can change deadlines or add Challenges. 4. Each scheme has its own page under https://eic.ec.europa.eu/eic-funding-opportunities/ (for example eic-pathfinder_en, eic-transition_en, eic-accelerator_en, advanced-innovation-challenges-pilot_en), with deadlines and sub-pages per Challenge (for example .../eic-pathfinder/eic-pathfinder-challenges-2027/<challenge>_en). On 17 November 2026 the Challenge pages only referred back to the Work Programme and linked no Challenge Guide yet; look for the Challenge Guides there and on the Funding & Tenders Portal topic page once published. 5. EIC Accelerator full proposals are batched at several cut-offs a year (2027: 20/01, 17/03, 01/09, 04/11); short proposals can be submitted at any time. Record one FO per Accelerator call (Open, and each Challenge) per year, using the next cut-off that has not passed as full_proposal_deadline. 6. The Funding & Tenders Portal topic page of each call (opened from the scheme page once the call opens) holds the templates and topic updates; it is a JavaScript page that needs a browser. 7. On 17 November 2026 the run recorded Pathfinder Open, the three Pathfinder Challenges and Transition Open for 2027; the next run should start with the EIC Advanced Innovation Challenges Step 2 (restricted to Step 1 awardees), EIC Accelerator Open, the four Accelerator Challenges and the other grant calls in Sections VIII-X.
parameters_passed_to_the_agent.link_scope: Pages under eic.ec.europa.eu/eic-funding-opportunities/ and the EIC Work Programme, Challenge Guides, factsheets and FAQs they link to (eic.ec.europa.eu/document/download/ and eic.ec.europa.eu/eic-frequently-asked-questions/), and the EIC topic pages and documents on ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/. Do not follow links to news, events, EIC Community or Marketplace, success stories, the submission system, login pages, or copies of the Work Programme on national contact point websites.
parameters_passed_to_the_agent.completion_rules: The run is complete when every call of the current EIC Work Programme within the search scope has been checked against the known-calls list and every open or forthcoming one not yet recorded has been read in the Work Programme and on its scheme page. If the run reaches the cap of 5 new candidates first, stop there: later runs skip the calls already recorded and find the rest. When a new Work Programme or an amendment is published, check it for new calls, Challenges and changed deadlines. A run that finds no new call ends with no new FO.
